steps.text: Boil a big pot of salted water and cook the linguine until al dente.
steps.label: Linguine

steps.text: Brown the beef in a wide pan with garlic powder, salt and pepper. Break it up as it cooks.
steps.label: Brown beef

steps.text: Stir in the Prego and simmer.
steps.label: Simmer sauce

steps.text: Steam the broccoli bag in the microwave.
steps.label: Broccoli

steps.text: Toss the pasta with the sauce. Portion into containers with broccoli on the side. Fry an egg fresh when you eat it.
Rinse the rice and start it in the rice cooker or a covered pot.
steps.label: Rice

steps.text: Brown the beef with garlic powder, salt and pepper. Splash in soy sauce at the end.
steps.label: Brown beef

steps.text: Steam the broccoli bag in the microwave.
steps.label: Broccoli

steps.text: Portion rice, beef and broccoli into containers. Fry two eggs fresh when you eat it.

name: Beef Spaghetti with Veg and Cheddar

steps.text: Boil salted water and cook the spaghetti.
steps.label: Spaghetti

steps.text: Brown the beef with garlic powder, salt and pepper.
steps.label: Brown beef

steps.text: Add the frozen mixed veg and the Prego. Simmer until the veg is hot.
steps.label: Simmer

steps.text: Toss with the spaghetti, portion, and grate cheddar on top.

name: Beef Avocado Rice Bowl with Fried Egg

steps.text: Start the rice.
steps.label: Rice

steps.text: Brown the beef with garlic powder, salt and pepper.
steps.label: Brown beef

steps.text: Stir the frozen mixed veg into the beef until hot.
steps.label: Veg

steps.text: Portion rice and beef. Slice the avocado and fry the eggs fresh when you eat it.
Start the rice.
steps.label: Rice

steps.text: Cut the thighs into bite-size pieces. Sear in a hot oiled pan without moving them, then stir.
steps.label: Sear chicken

steps.text: Add the frozen mixed veg and stir fry on high.
steps.label: Veg

steps.text: Add soy sauce, oyster sauce and a pinch of garlic powder. Toss until glossy.
steps.label: Sauce

steps.text: Portion over rice.

name: Air-Fryer Thighs, Sweet Potato and Broccoli

steps.text: Cut the sweet potato into 1-inch cubes. Toss with oil and salt.
steps.label: Prep

steps.text: Air-fry the sweet potato at 400F, 15-18 min. Shake halfway.
steps.label: Sweet potato 400F

steps.text: Season the thighs with smoked paprika (about 1 tsp per serving, more turns bitter), garlic powder, salt and pepper.
steps.label: Season

steps.text: Air-fry the thighs at 380F, 18-22 min, flip halfway. Done at 175F inside.
steps.label: Thighs 380F

steps.text: Steam the broccoli bag in the microwave.
steps.label: Broccoli

steps.text: Portion into containers. Reheat at 350F in the air fryer for 4-5 min.

name: Air-Fryer Thighs with Rice and Broccoli

steps.text: Start the rice.
steps.label: Rice

steps.text: Season the thighs with smoked paprika, garlic powder, salt and pepper.
steps.label: Season

steps.text: Air-fry the thighs at 380F, 18-22 min, flip halfway. Done at 175F inside.
steps.label: Thighs 380F

steps.text: Steam the broccoli bag in the microwave.
steps.label: Broccoli

steps.text: Slice the thighs and portion over rice with broccoli. Reheat at 350F for 4-5 min.
Boil salted water and cook the rigatoni.
steps.label: Rigatoni

steps.text: Season the thighs with garlic powder, salt and pepper. Air-fry at 380F, 18-22 min, flip halfway.
steps.label: Thighs 380F

steps.text: Steam the broccoli bag in the microwave.
steps.label: Broccoli

steps.text: Slice the chicken. Warm the Alfredo in the pasta pot, then toss in the rigatoni, chicken and broccoli.
steps.label: Toss

steps.text: Portion. An opened Alfredo jar keeps about 5 days, so use one jar per week.
Boil salted water and cook the rigatoni.
steps.label: Rigatoni

steps.text: Season the salmon with salt, pepper and garlic powder. Air-fry at 400F, 8-10 min, skin side down. Check at 8.
steps.label: Salmon 400F

steps.text: Steam the broccoli bag in the microwave.
steps.label: Broccoli

steps.text: Flake the salmon. Warm the Alfredo, then fold in rigatoni, salmon and broccoli.
steps.label: Toss

steps.text: Portion. Salmon keeps 3 days in the fridge, so eat these first.
Start the rice.
steps.label: Rice

steps.text: Mix the glaze: soy sauce, oyster sauce, garlic powder and a splash of water.
steps.label: Glaze

steps.text: Sear the thighs in an oiled pan, 5 min per side.
steps.label: Sear thighs

steps.text: Pour in the glaze and let it bubble and coat the chicken.
steps.label: Glaze

steps.text: Slice and portion over rice with broccoli. Fry an egg fresh when you eat it.

name: Fried Rice with Eggs and Peas

steps.text: Use cold, day-old rice if you have it. Otherwise cook it and spread it on a tray to cool.
steps.label: Rice

steps.text: Cook the protein in a hot oiled pan (diced chicken or crumbled beef) and set aside.
steps.label: Protein

steps.text: Scramble the eggs in the same pan, then add the mixed veg.
steps.label: Eggs + veg

steps.text: Add the rice and fry on high, pressing it flat, then tossing.
steps.label: Fry rice

steps.text: Return the protein, add soy sauce, toss and portion.
Start the rice, or reheat batch rice.
steps.label: Rice

steps.text: Season the salmon with salt, pepper and garlic powder. Air-fry at 400F, 8-10 min, skin side down. Check at 8.
steps.label: Salmon 400F

steps.text: Melt the butter with garlic powder and spoon it over the salmon.
steps.label: Garlic butter

steps.text: Fry an egg. Build the bowl: rice, salmon, broccoli, egg on top.

name: Pad Kra Pao with Fried Egg

steps.text: Start the rice, or reheat batch rice.
steps.label: Rice

steps.text: Fry garlic and chili in a hot oiled pan until fragrant.
steps.label: Garlic + chili

steps.text: Add the pork and cook, breaking it up, until browned.
steps.label: Pork

steps.text: Add fish sauce, oyster sauce and soy sauce. Toss.
steps.label: Sauce

steps.text: Off the heat, fold in the Thai basil. Serve over rice with a crispy fried egg. This one does not reheat well.

name: Air-Fried Shrimp, Broccoli and Fried Eggs

steps.text: Start the rice, or reheat batch rice.
steps.label: Rice

steps.text: Thaw the shrimp under cold water, pat dry, toss with oil, garlic powder, salt and pepper.
steps.label: Prep shrimp

steps.text: Air-fry the shrimp at 400F, 6-8 min, shake halfway.
steps.label: Shrimp 400F

steps.text: Steam the broccoli and fry two eggs. Build the bowl.
Use cold rice if you have it.
steps.label: Rice

steps.text: Sear the shrimp in a hot oiled pan and set aside.
steps.label: Shrimp

steps.text: Fry the chopped kimchi until it caramelizes a little.
steps.label: Kimchi

steps.text: Add the rice and peas, fry on high, then return the shrimp.
steps.label: Fry rice

steps.text: Top with fried eggs.
Cube the sweet potato, toss with oil and salt, and air-fry at 400F, 15-18 min. Shake halfway.
steps.label: Sweet potato 400F

steps.text: Pat the steak dry and salt it well. Heat a pan until it smokes.
steps.label: Prep steak

steps.text: Sear the ribeye 3-4 min per side.
steps.label: Sear

steps.text: Add butter and garlic powder, baste for a minute.
steps.label: Baste

steps.text: Rest the steak before slicing.
steps.label: Rest
